deadline.intake: September 2027 bachelor's (final deadline for visa-bearing nationals 24 May 2027; early bird 20 Jan 2027; non-visa nationals 12 Aug 2027)

tuition.note: Non-EEA, per year, International Business BSc (3,500 EUR per semester); other programmes 6,600-7,000 EUR per year

requirement.text: Entrance exams (or exam exemptions) apply; an application fee of 100 EUR is required to start the official application. English proficiency is required (details on the university's admissions requirements pages).
